spans.s: Śauca (‘descendant of Śuci’) is the patronymic of a man, called also āhneya, who is mentioned as a teacher in the taittirīya Āraṇyaka (ii. 12).
Śaucad-ratha (‘descendant of Śucad-ratha’) is the patronymic of Sunītha in the Rigveda (v. 79, 2).

Śauceya (‘descendant of Śuci’) prācīnayogya (‘descendant of Prācīnayoga’) is the name of a teacher in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa (xi. 5, 3, 1. 8). śauceya is also the patronymic of sārvaseni in the taittirīya Saṃhitā (vii. 1, 10, 2).
